slices.title: 用 exact-one serialized owner permit 切断 memory-terminal 全局组合锥
slices.domain: RV64 serialized owner lifetime, memory terminal accounting and drain timing
slices.action: 新增一个只服务 non-CSR system、architectural trap 与 simulation exit 的 owner-bound cancellable permit：在 backend_drained_q 与 exact current mem_owner_terminalized 同拍捕获三位 one-hot owner，消费拍比较当前 owner，所有 reset/flush/cancel/consume/handoff clear-dominant；OooPendingDrainResolveGate 继续当拍重查 raw backend drain、FENCE mem_idle 与既有 trap/exit/CSR priority。不得实现或复用无 owner 身份的一位 readiness。
required_evidence: owner-bound helper arm hold consume stop-drop and C1 no-repeat
owner A-to-B mismatch non-onehot rejection and every cancel collision
new memory birth active-holder and collector-pending exact-accounting counterexamples
raw backend drain FENCE current mem_idle and ROB-head trap priority remain live
compile-success mutations for owner compare clear priority raw drain and FENCE idle
affected L0/L1 plus same-design CoreMark Dhrystone and two fresh mapped timing runs
success_conditions: all candidate invariants and negative variants are observed non-vacuously
serialized system trap exit and FENCE order remain exact with no repeated terminal request
collector tracker token accounting and all ready/valid payload stability contracts remain unchanged
same-design CPI floors hold and the target mem_owner_terminalized to drain_complete family leaves mapped Top40 or the candidate is rejected
the 5 ns timing hard gate remains explicit even if WNS improves but stays negative
rollback_conditions: any owner can consume a permit captured by another owner or generation
flush cancel consume or owner mismatch can lose clear priority
raw backend drain FENCE current idle or ROB-head trap priority is bypassed
memory terminal token is dropped duplicated or freed by the permit
functional assertion CPI area or same-config timing evidence regresses outside the declared bound
forbidden_claims: production promotion from owner-lifetime analysis or directed TB alone
5 ns closure when WNS remains negative
qualified power or macro area when either remains unknown
